messages:
Aisha: quick question — Console v2 density tradeoff. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/abc123 :link: Should we keep the more compact table rows (8px vertical padding) to fit more items on dashboard or bump to 12px to meet touch + keyboard hit targets? Also noticed toasts overlap row actions in this mock.
Michael: my vote is 12px for accessibility. tiny rows feel cramped when the focus ring appears and on touch devices it becomes fiddly. we can keep visual density by reducing icon spacing instead of row height.
Devon: agree with Michael. also can we standardize token names before we tweak spacing? currently we have `spacing.compact`, `spacing.default`, and a bunch of unnamed numbers. makes searching harder.
Sam: quick copy nit — the row action currently says `Export` but users expect `Download CSV`. small change but helps discoverability.
Aisha: good catches. would love a minimal CSS diff to review. Michael, can you mock both variants in storybook? we can do a quick runway A/B.
Michael: yep — I'll add two stories: `Table/RowDensity/compact` and `Table/RowDensity/accessible`. dropping the token proposals here for clarity:
```
:root {
  --space-compact: 8px; /* current */
  --space-touch: 12px;   /* proposed */
  --row-min-height-compact: 32px;
  --row-min-height-touch: 40px;
}
```
Devon: for token naming I propose `space.2xs`, `space.xs`, `space.sm` (align with other libs) or `space.compact`, `space.touch`. leaning toward `space.compact` to avoid renaming churn.
design-lint-bot: accessibility: contrast ratio 3.8:1 for `.btn-secondary` (bg #ECECEC on #FFFFFF). WCAG AA requires 4.5:1. Suggest darker stroke or #DADADA -> #BDBDBD.
Sam: noted — I'll update button palette for the secondary and add aria-labels to the icon-only actions. also will patch toast stacking: set `z-index: 1200` and add `pointer-events: auto` so toast hover doesn't block row actions.
Aisha: perfect. let's prototype both densities and run a quick a11y check. if the accessible variant only costs a row or two on the dashboard, we should default to the higher hit-target one.
Michael: I'll have mocks + storybook link by EOD, will include screenshots for mobile widths.
Devon: I'll open the token rename PR with a migration table (old -> new) so we can review before merging.
Sam: I'll follow up with the copy PR (Export -> Download CSV) and the toast z-index patch.
Aisha: thanks team :thumbsup: will pick up the a/b plan once Michael shares the stories.
